title: Not sure better than regular sheets
text: Not sure better than regular sheets. I was frustrated using queen sheets on the hospital bed because I felt they didn’t stay tucked under the mattress so I bought these. Initially, the fitted sheet fit well but tends to slide to one side when scooting in bed and getting off the bed. They are quite rough. They wash well.
